title: Autograph
desc: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.

title: Kadalora Kavithaigal
desc: A teacher's heart is captured by a rough criminal. She believes love can transform even the most difficult soul, and sets out to prove it through their unexpected romance.

title: Vaimaye Vellum
desc: Raja, a rickshaw driver, shares a complicated relationship with his father. Things take a turn when a journalist investigating an ongoing crime hires him to protect his daughter.

title: Three Roses
desc: When Charulatha, Nandhu and Pooja return from abroad, they find out that their friend has been arrested for travelling on a fake passport. Upon learning about her innocence, they decide to help her.

title: Chinna
desc: Chinna, a gangster, changes his way of life after he falls in love with Gayatri. However, he ends up in jail after he kills a gang leader in order to save Gayatri.
